data.name: Mamdooh
data.gender_notes: Mamdooh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mamd' which means 'to hope' or 'to expect'. In Islamic history, Prophet Yunus (Jonah) is an example of a righteous man who was hopeful in Allah's mercy and was saved from the belly of the whale. The name Mamdooh carries the meaning “Hopeful, Expectant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mamdooh usually hope their child will grow to embody hopeful, expectant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mamdooh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing good character and moral excellence.
